items.name: 02_du
items.text: 烽火连三月，家书抵万金。

items.name: 04_scott
items.text: Au clair de la lune, mon ami Pierrot, prête-moi ta plume, pour écrire un mot.

items.name: 05_bell
items.text: Mr. Watson, come here. I want to see you.

items.name: 06_marconi
items.text: Can you hear anything, Mr. Kemp?

items.name: 07_kline
items.text: Did you get the L? ... Did you get the O?

items.name: 08_beijing
items.text: Across the Great Wall, we can reach every corner in the world.

items.name: 09_voyager
items.text: 各位都好吧？我们都很想念你们，有空请到这儿来玩。
